name: web-blue-and-black-bento-with-mountain-photo-stat-tiles-and-explorer-pass
title: Blue-toned bento: a large misty-mountain hero card, a blue gradient stat tile, a white feature card, a black CTA tile, a dark community stat and a bright blue 94% tile
whatItIs: A bento of rounded tiles: a big blue-tinted photo card of mountains and mist with a 'Live Adventures' pill and 'Explore Beyond Boundaries', a top-right blue gradient tile '2,847 Peaks Conquered' with an icon, a white 'Instant Routes' card, a black 'Get Your Explorer Pass' tile with a JOIN NOW pill and arrow, a near-black tile '18.2k+ ACTIVE COMMUNITY' in blue numerals with a corner dot and a saturated blue tile '94% SATISFACTION RATE'.
whatItMeans: Crisp and lively; a blue, black and white palette makes stats and photography read as one brand.
techniques: Tint a photo tile in the brand blue.
Use bright and dark tiles for stats.
Mix white feature cards with colour tiles.
Add small pills and icon squares.

vocabulary.definition: A photo card overlaid with a brand colour.
A tile with a large figure and label.
A hero built from mixed-size tiles.
